compositions.description: This is a little demo I put together in the summer of 2026 for a potential song on my senior recital the following spring. The music is inspired by the bossa nova stylings of Jobim and the like, as well as the children's book series "I Spy", specifically "I Spy Treasure Hunt".

compositions.description: This is something I composed in a jazz composition course taught by Sasha Berliner. Initially performed at the end-of-quarter concert, this is another take from a studio session I put together for my classmates and I to have our compositions on record (see below).

compositions.description: Here's my first composition ever heard by an audience. The members of my combo that quarter all brought in originals, so we decided to make it an all-originals set. I had been mulling some of these ideas over for a while and came up with this tune.

engineering.description: (YouTube playlist) In winter of 2026, I took a composition class with Sasha Berliner. At the end of it my friends and I wanted to have recordings of our compositions beside the live recording of the concert, so I volunteered to engineer a session.
